findings.source_quote: The early church in olden days / Had a desire to tell / The sinner about Jesus Christ
findings.suggested_fix:
Replace the stanza text with: "Kanisa la kwanza siku za kale
lilitamani kuwaambia
wadhambi kuhusu Yesu Kristo,
kuhusu Mbingu na kuzimu."
findings.translation_quote: Kanisa la kwanza zamani za kale / Lilitamani kuwaambia / Wenye dhambi kuhusu Yesu Kristo

findings.source_quote: And strove to follow this command / In spite of peril and sword.
findings.suggested_fix:
Replace the last two lines with: "Na wakajitahidi kufuata amri hii
Licha ya hatari na upanga."
findings.translation_quote: Na wakajitahidi kutii amri hii / Licha ya hatari na upanga.

findings.source_quote: A lot of folks were burned at stake
findings.suggested_fix: Replace “Watu wengi walichomwa kwenye mti wa mateso” with “Watu wengi walichomwa kwenye mti wa kuchomea.”
findings.translation_quote: Watu wengi walichomwa kwenye mti wa mateso

findings.source_quote: Since faith is good, why don’t we share / As did the saints of old?
findings.suggested_fix:
Replace the last two lines with: "Kwa kuwa imani ni njema, kwa nini tusishiriki
Kama walivyofanya watakatifu wa zamani?"
findings.translation_quote: Kwa kuwa imani ni njema, kwa nini hatuishiriki / Kama watakatifu wa zamani?

findings.suggested_fix: Replace “Na wanapambana kwa nguvu” with “Na wana juhudi kubwa katika mapambano.”

findings.source_quote: They praise their Lord on high. / And thank Him that for Jesus’ sake
findings.suggested_fix: Replace “Wao wanamsifu Bwana wao aliye juu. / Na wanamshukuru kwamba kwa ajili ya Yesu” with “Wao wanamsifu Bwana wao aliye juu, / na wanamshukuru kwamba kwa ajili ya Yesu Kristo”.
findings.translation_quote: Wao wanamsifu Bwana wao aliye juu. / Na wanamshukuru kwamba kwa ajili ya Yesu

findings.source_quote: If we would also spread God’s Word, / Our blood would stain our sod.
findings.suggested_fix:
Replace the last two lines with: "Ikiwa sisi pia tungeeneza Neno la Mungu,
Damu yetu ingeitia doa ardhi yetu."
findings.translation_quote: Ikiwa sisi pia tutaeneza Neno la Mungu, / Damu yetu itatia doa ardhi yetu.

findings.source_quote: If we don’t bring the folks to God, / The populace will die.
findings.suggested_fix: Replace “Tusipowaleta watu kwa Mungu, / Wananchi watakufa” with “Tusipowaleta watu kwa Mungu, / watu wengi watakufa.”
findings.translation_quote: Tusipowaleta watu kwa Mungu, / Wananchi watakufa.

findings.source_quote: Showing lost souls, the narrow way, / That leads men home to God.
findings.suggested_fix:
Replace the last two lines with: "Tukiwaonyesha roho zilizopotea njia nyembamba,
inayowaongoza watu kurudi nyumbani kwa Mungu."
findings.translation_quote: Tukiwaonyesha waliopotea njia nyembamba, / Inayowaongoza watu nyumbani kwa Mungu.

gpt-4.1-mini.quality_note: Default cost-conscious candidate; not certified for theological accuracy in every language.

gpt-4.1-nano.quality_note: Lowest-cost option in this registry; benchmark before bulk publication.

gpt-5-mini.quality_note: Reasoning tokens consume output budget; benchmark total cost and quality.

gpt-6-luna.quality_note: Affordable default for new manual translation and review campaigns. Documented API alias; no dated snapshot is published. Reasoning shares the output cap. Benchmark theological accuracy; quality gates remain required.
